env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Both orders build under the default limit. At a limit below the
# true Outer-plus-Leaf chain, both orders must fail: reusing the
# cached Leaf inside Outer still charges its subtree.
cd w
logos build ./...
! logos build -o $WORK/a.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=430 ./a
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
! logos build -o $WORK/b.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=430 ./b
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/nodeorder

go 1.27

-- w/a/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Wide struct {
	F0 int
	F1 int
	F2 int
	F3 int
	F4 int
	F5 int
	F6 int
	F7 int
	F8 int
	F9 int
	F10 int
	F11 int
	F12 int
	F13 int
	F14 int
	F15 int
	F16 int
	F17 int
	F18 int
	F19 int
	F20 int
	F21 int
	F22 int
	F23 int
	F24 int
	F25 int
	F26 int
	F27 int
	F28 int
	F29 int
}

func Leaf[T any]() int {
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
	}
	return 1
}

func Outer[T any]() int {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return Leaf[T]() + 1
	}
	return 0
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Leaf[Wide]())
	fmt.Println(Outer[Wide]())
}

-- w/b/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Wide struct {
	F0 int
	F1 int
	F2 int
	F3 int
	F4 int
	F5 int
	F6 int
	F7 int
	F8 int
	F9 int
	F10 int
	F11 int
	F12 int
	F13 int
	F14 int
	F15 int
	F16 int
	F17 int
	F18 int
	F19 int
	F20 int
	F21 int
	F22 int
	F23 int
	F24 int
	F25 int
	F26 int
	F27 int
	F28 int
	F29 int
}

func Leaf[T any]() int {
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
	}
	return 1
}

func Outer[T any]() int {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return Leaf[T]() + 1
	}
	return 0
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Outer[Wide]())
	fmt.Println(Leaf[Wide]())
}
